summary.en: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko visit their old middle school music teacher, Sayuri Matsumoto, as she prepares for her wedding to Toshihiko Takasugi. Sayuri teases Conan because he reminds her of a boy she once taught. Conan manages to escape suspicion before too many parallels to Shinichi are noticed.

suspects: Atsushi Umemiya, Toshihiko Takasugi, Kazumi Takenaka, Kiyonaga Matsumoto, Ran Mouri, Sonoko Suzuki, and Conan Edogawa
